ppo_objective_validity.reason: Per-graph clipped PPO terms already exist before actor aggregation. Positive bounded group weights can define an explicit alternative surrogate, without claiming to optimize the original UTR objective.

training_only_isolation.reason: condition_group is rollout metadata outside model inputs; the fixed-stratified sampler is uniform over failure groups and contains no adaptive q.

cost_and_matched_collection.reason: Reweighting already-computed per-graph actor terms is O(batch size), uses no extra environment interactions, probes, or policy forwards, and preserves fixed exposure.
